products.name: Beamery
products.note: Talent lifecycle management AI; skills ontology; DEI analytics; UK-hosted; GDPR relevant

profile_text.body:
Beamery is an enterprise software company that describes itself as offering an AI-powered Workforce Transformation Platform, designed to help organizations align talent strategy, plan workforce needs, and support employee development. Its platform spans hiring, skills management, career pathing, and workforce intelligence, and is positioned for large enterprises seeking to integrate AI across their HR technology ecosystems.

The company's core product suite includes a Workforce Intelligence Suite for scenario modeling and talent risk management, a Talent CRM with real-time AI-powered recommendations, and sourcing and matching tools built around skills data. Beamery also offers an embedded agentic AI advisor called Ray, described as an AI Talent Advisor that delivers context-aware recommendations and accelerates HR workflows. The held facts note that the platform incorporates a skills ontology, DEI analytics, and UK hosting, with GDPR compliance relevance. Beamery names Flex and Salesforce as enterprise customers, describing how Flex used the platform to convert unstructured job descriptions into a customized skills framework, and how Salesforce used it to improve hire quality and data reliability through an integrated Talent CRM.

No litigation, SEC filings, patent records, or MCP server registrations appear in the available data for Beamery.
